lessons.title: Verify Stripe webhook signatures before trusting events
lessons.problem: Unverified webhooks let attackers forge subscription state.
lessons.fix: In stripe_webhooks, check the Stripe-Signature header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET before mutating subscription_status.
lessons.resolution: stripe_webhooks now implements signature verification + an idempotency ledger (ProcessedEvent).

lessons.title: Default journals to private and encrypt at rest
lessons.problem: Recovery journals are highly sensitive; a plaintext default risks exposure.
lessons.fix: Set JournalEntry.private=True by default and apply field_encryption to the body column.

lessons.title: JWTs need short TTL + revocation at scale
lessons.problem: Long-lived stateless JWTs can't be revoked, a liability as user count grows.
lessons.fix: Keep access tokens short-lived, issue refresh tokens, and maintain a revocation list once past MVP.
